assumptions: FY2027 is a 53-week fiscal year ending the last Sunday in January (Jan. 31, 2027); its Q4 is 14 weeks per the July 2026 10-Q. Six-month FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS reported through Jul. 26 was $4.85. Scenario annual GAAP EPS assumptions explicitly add hypothetical H2 residual EPS of $3.15/$4.85/$6.65 to that reported amount, using a constant-share approximation: bear $8.00, base $9.70, bull $11.50. Bear tests lower accelerator demand or mix/margin and a valuation de-rating; base holds H1 earnings run-rate in H2; bull tests continued demand/mix and higher valuation. These are not guidance, consensus, forecasts, or empirically fair multiples. GAAP EPS includes material other income, including six-month equity-security gains, so the operating bridge is not fully recurring. Hypothetical P/E inputs: 18, 24.1185567010 (equals the dated close at $9.70 EPS), and 28.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
